# 3d-glass-layer

<!-- Generated by `iig3d.py docs` from catalogue/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Member of the 3D corporate family. Exploded stack of translucent isometric plates with pill tabs. Backdrop: Pure white. Items: 3 to 7. Default aspect: landscape.

## Colour palette

- Cool ramp default, top to bottom: frosted white #E8ECF5, lavender #A99BE0, cyan #3FD4F2, teal #2FB5A8, royal blue #2456C4; numeral circles tinted to match their plate
- Family cycle allowed when layers are peers rather than a ramp
- Plates 60 to 80 percent opaque with a thin lighter edge highlight; pure white backdrop #FFFFFF, no studio gradient
- Text navy #1C2A4A for titles and tabs, charcoal #2B2F36 for descriptions

## Visual elements

- Plates: isometric rhombus slabs at 30 degrees, 4 to 6 percent thick, equal size, centred on one vertical axis
- Gaps between plates equal to roughly one plate thickness times three, so the stack reads as exploded
- Tabs: white pill outlined in navy, tinted circle with the numeral at the left end, layer name in bold; description in light text beneath the tab
- Connectors: thin navy lines from the tab to the nearest plate corner, dot terminal at the plate
- Title top-left, two-tone: bold blue first line, lighter navy second line

## Typography

- Family typography; layer names bold mixed case in navy, numerals medium weight inside the circle, descriptions light charcoal

## Composition rules

- Three to seven plates; more than seven, switch to 3d-slab-stack
- Landscape: stack centred, tabs alternate left and right, odd numbers left
- Portrait: stack centred, tabs all on the right, numerals descend
- Top plate is the outermost or user-facing layer, base plate is the foundation; state the reading direction in the content block
- Nothing sits on the plates; all text lives in the tabs

## Layout

### Structure

- Three to seven equal isometric plates centred on one vertical axis
- Even gaps between plates so every plate stays visible
- Numbered pill tab per plate, alternating left and right
- Thin connector from each tab to the nearest plate corner
- Description text under each tab

### Variants

| Variant | Focus | Visual Emphasis |
|---------|-------|-----------------|
| **Exploded stack** | Architecture and reference layers | Tabs alternate left and right |
| **Single column** | Portrait, many layers | Tabs all on the right, numerals descend |
| **Waterline** | Visible versus hidden layers | Plates above and below a line, opacity fades with depth |
| **Floating floors** | Site or platform tiers | Plates carry small isometric blocks |

### Visual Elements

- Translucent glass plates, cool gradient from frosted white to royal blue
- Thin lighter edge highlight on every plate
- White pill tabs outlined in navy, tinted numeral circle
- Thin navy connectors with dot terminals
- Pure white backdrop, shadow only under the base plate

### Text Placement

- Title top-left, two-tone
- Layer name inside the tab beside the numeral
- Two-line description under the tab
- Nothing on the plates themselves
- State the reading direction (top is outermost) in the title or a footnote
